doc.title: Jason Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2025

title: End of the semester at Berklee and New England Conservatory
summary: Palmer describes finishing his teaching, grades and NEC promotionals.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: Well it’s early May and you have Berklee and the New England Conservatory. I wonder if it’s sort of crunch time for you and your students?

Yeah. Well I had my last teaching day on Wednesday, so I’m all set with the classroom stuff, I just have to turn my grades in and I have promotionals at New England Conservatory on Monday so I’ll be truly finished at the end of the day on Monday. So but yeah it was a race to the finish line with all the recitals and finals and all that stuff, so, but yeah, it was a joy to work with the young artists.
